description:
Transformers, Ice Age: Collision Course, Independence Day, Armageddon, and so many other end-of-the-world movies all push the same storyline—cosmic threats, alien invasions, and humanity “saving itself” from extinction. But why does Hollywood keep repeating this narrative? 🤔

In this LED Live episode, we break down the apocalypse movie trend, the rise of alien-invasion storylines, and the deeper end-times messaging behind today’s biggest blockbusters. We compare these films with Bible prophecy—joined by a Christian geologist who brings scientific and scriptural insight into what Hollywood gets wrong about the end of the world.

📖 Get Ryan’s book here: https://www.remnantrendezvous.org/revelationsgeology
